To solve this problem, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is $32,$ and the percentage is $225%.$ 

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
225%=225÷100=2.25
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =225%\times 32 \\  & =2.25\times 32 \\  & =72\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $225%$ of $32$ is $72.$

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
225%=\frac{225}{100}=\frac{225÷25}{100÷25}=\frac{9}{4}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =225%\times 32 \\  & =\frac{9}{4}\times 32 \\  & =9\times \frac{32}{4} \\  & =9\times 8 \\  & =72\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $225%$ of $32$ is $72.$
